note: Hand grades of the first holdout bench run (ho1, ho1-clean), by the lead build session on 28 Oct 2026, 23:45 Halifax, reading each report's title, actual and evidence against bench/holdout/SEALED-bugs.json and the game source. The scorer's flag-only count said 5 of 5; that count used the bug flags that fired, not the reports. The two reports that match no planted bug were then replayed in the Node simulator at $0: both refuted (the player touched the spikes).

reports.title: Second gem pickup adds 2 gems instead of 1

Step 38: the same from y 223 to 237. Each heart was lost by touching the spikes; the agent saw the player after the respawn.
